chunks: 5033 - And it is narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Muʾmin, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “Is zina worse, or drinking wine? And how is it that in wine there are eighty, while in zina there are one hundred?”
So he said: “O Isḥāq, the hadd is one, but this was increased because of his wasting the sperm-drop and placing it in other than its proper place which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, commanded for it.”
ai.seo_question: Why is the punishment for zina greater than the punishment for drinking wine in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the legal distinction between the hadd punishment for drinking wine and for zina. Imām al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that the increase in zina is due to the wasting of the nuṭfah and placing it outside the divinely appointed place.
